summary: Frontend-only testing for AMYA brand-story round. Verified homepage new sections (prepared-with-care, heart-behind-amya, ingredient-sourcing, recipes-with-a-story), per-product recipe story attribution matrix (Leela/Ammu/Ammamma) across all 7 story products, absence of recipe story on products without stories (cashew-brittle, chilli, oil, garam masala), made-to-order block on orderable items and absence on non-orderable (oils=coming-soon, avakai/maagai=out-of-stock), AMYA Quality Promise + refund link on every product page, /refund-policy page content and WhatsApp CTA, footer links (prepared-with-care hash-scroll + refund-replacement route), and mobile responsiveness at 390px with no horizontal overflow. ALL 56 assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: RefundPolicy.jsx bottom link to /policies/refund works but 'View cancellation & refund terms' may be confusing since both pages are refund-related — minor UX note, not a bug.
Console shows repeated 401s on /api/admin/* (ping/me) when visiting any public page — harmless but noisy; main agent could gate admin-config fetch to admin routes only.
